title: tmx test-matrix engine
description: Stdlib-only engine: per-test coverage + kill matrix collection (pytest, Stryker, PIT), certified set-cover reduction, verify/compare/subsumes, smells/clones, covering arrays, probation lifecycle, rigor-aware gate.

acceptanceCriteria.text: tmx subcommands documented and covered by the engine suite
Self-audit kill matrix recorded with per-module scores
Collector control run rejects a non-green harness

finalSummary: tmx engine: collect-pytest (per-test coverage, kill matrix; survival confirmed on the full suite; hangs attributed per test; unique regenerable keys; control run; money-shaped operators; --history, --extra-mutants), import-stryker/pit, score, analyze (set cover with component decomposition, certificate, curve, --csv), verify [--rerun], subsumes, compare, probation (atomic prune from collected-case ground truth), smells, clones, covering (feasible t-tuples), baseline, gate (rigor-aware, base-ref policy, certified demotion). Evidence: every subcommand has a test (58 tests; PR tier 52 in ~5 s, slow tier 7 in ~60 s). 14 regression tests for the review findings and the vacuous-100% bug fail on pre-fix engines and pass now. Self-audit recorded: PR tier 39.1% over 1,078 mutants (cover 49%, gate 65%, rigor 61%, mutate_py 79%; pycollect/probation covered only by the slow tier). Honest caveat: the engine does not yet meet its own R4 floor, tracked as TS-11.
